layers.name: Task Workbench & Dispatcher
layers.body: The sole user focus and command center. Provides a unified task overview, dispatches concurrent tasks across multiple background browser instances, and delivers full-timeline execution replay and status auditing.
bullets: Unified Console: Natural language intent parsing and multi-task concurrency scheduling
Multi-Browser Fleet: Dispatches atomic actions across isolated background browser instances
DVR-Grade Replay: Full-timeline video playback, audit events, and state snapshots
Native HITL: Seamless millisecond screen takeover on 2FA or critical checkpoints

layers.name: Dedicated Agent Harness
layers.body: The dedicated execution bridge between the dispatcher and browser fleet. Features anti-hallucination parameter validation, semantic feedback loops, and zero-trust security guardrails for multi-task concurrency.
bullets: Anti-Hallucination: Built-in Zod Schema strict validation to prevent malformed actions
Observation Feedback: Precise structured DOM and visual state translation back to the Agent
Zero-Trust Policy Gateway: Sensitive operation blocking, domain whitelisting, and injection defense
Environment Isolation: Process-level lifecycle management and resource throttling

layers.name: Custom Page Engine
layers.body: Multiple browser instances run quietly and isolated in the background. Engineered specifically for high-throughput atomic actions to deliver structured outcomes with ultra-low resource overhead.
bullets: Action Throughput: Tailored custom engine executing atomic browser actions in milliseconds
Unobtrusive Operation: Browsers stay in the background with zero popups or distractions
Token Optimization: Intelligent DOM pruning to drastically reduce model context token costs
High-Fidelity Delivery: Cross-page structured data extraction and verified artifact export
